originals.why: Natural Welsh. Uses ti wedi gwneud in the sense this course taught, 'you have done'.

originals.ko: 내가 네가 아주 잘 했다고 생각한다고
originals.why: Natural Welsh. The 'that' clause is an open fragment, which is fine for a BUILD row.

originals.ko: 나는 네가 아주 잘 했다고 말하고 싶어
originals.why: Natural North Welsh. Same sense of ti wedi gwneud.

originals.ko: 너는 내가 하고 싶었던 것을 했어
originals.why: Natural Welsh, and it sits well next to this seed's 'what you needed to do'.

originals.ko: 나는 네가 아주 잘 했다고 생각한다고 말하고 싶었어
originals.why: Natural Welsh. The one subject 나는 covers both 'I wanted' and 'I think', as in the Welsh.

topups.why: Sound, but only 3 BUILD rows are needed and B03 already practises the same words with be'.

topups.ko: 나는 네가 왜 이렇게 일찍 떠날 필요가 있었는지 몰라
topups.why: Changed 모르겠어 to 몰라 to match 'dw i ddim yn gwybod' directly.

topups.ko: 너는 네가 들을 필요가 있었던 것을 들었어?
topups.why: Added the topic marker 는 so the line reads as natural 반말 with the pronoun explicit.
'아무도 … 확실하지 않았어' is stiff Korean, and only 5 USE rows are needed.
